title: POST /api/audio-gen writes under a caller-chosen setId with no containment check
body:
## Summary
POST accepted any string as setId and used it as a directory name under the audio root, so a setId such as ../x wrote the clip outside it.

## Description
src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts built the clip directory with join(AUDIO_DIR, set.id) where set.id came from body.setId (upsertSet inserts an unknown id verbatim). DELETE in the same file proves containment through resolveAudioPath (src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:223); POST did not. Fixed: a setId pattern is checked before the cache and any billed call, and the directory is resolved through resolveAudioPath.

## Flow
- POST {setId: '../escape', setName, prompt, kind, provider}
- route reaches generate() (billed), then join(AUDIO_DIR, '../escape')
- writeFileSync lands outside AUDIO_DIR

## Expected impact
Local-tool trust boundary: a scripted or MCP caller can no longer write clips outside the audio root. Could break callers using ids with dots or spaces; none exist (Forge sends UUIDs or omits setId).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience: POST refuses ids that escape the audio root before spending
Before: 5 traversal ids (../escape, ..backslash escape, a/b, /abs, ..) each reached the provider (0 of 5 refused)
After: 5 of 5 refused with 400 and 0 provider calls
Method: gate: new route test red then green
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts: join(AUDIO_DIR, set.id) vs src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:223 resolveAudioPath; test src/__tests__/api/audio-gen-route.test.ts 'refuses a setId that would escape'

title: POST /api/audio-gen forwards any durationSeconds to the billed provider
body:
## Summary
The Forge form constrains duration to 0.5-22 s (types.ts comment, input max=22) but the route forwarded negative, NaN-like, string or 1e9 values to ElevenLabs.

## Description
AudioGenRequest.durationSeconds documents 0.5-22 (src/lib/audio-gen/types.ts:304). The route read body.durationSeconds unvalidated into the cache hash and into provider.generate; a bad value was billed or failed as a 502 after the call. Fixed: a typeof/finite/range check runs before the cache and the provider call.

## Flow
- POST durationSeconds: 1e9 or 'long'
- hash computed, provider called
- provider 4xx surfaces as a 502 after the request

## Expected impact
Direct API/MCP callers get an explicit 400 naming the range instead of a provider error. Forge users typing 0.1 now see the 400 text rather than a provider error.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience: invalid duration refused before spend
Before: 6 invalid durations (-1, 0.1, 23, 1e9, 'long', null) reached the provider
After: 6 of 6 refused with 400, 0 provider calls; omitted and edge values 0.5 and 22 still 200
Method: gate: new route tests red then green
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts durationSeconds handling; src/lib/audio-gen/types.ts:304; tests in audio-gen-route.test.ts

title: Audio codegen escapes user text at one C++ site and interpolates it raw at eight others
body:
## Summary
The soundscape description was quote-escaped, but the hand-typed cue path, zone names, scene name and set name were interpolated raw into C++ literals and comments; a backslash defeated the one escape that existed.

## Description
src/lib/audio-codegen.ts built TEXT(...) literals and // and block comments from zone.name, doc.name, em.soundCueRef, binding.setName. A cue path containing a quote or backslash, or a name with a newline or a closing comment token, produced non-compiling or injected C++. Fixed with cppString (backslash first, then quote, line breaks to space) and cppComment (one line, cannot close a block).

## Flow
- user types a cue path with a quote in the property panel
- codegen emits TEXT(path) raw
- generated .cpp fails to compile or contains attacker-chosen statements

## Expected impact
Generated UE files compile for any scene content; output for ordinary names is byte-identical (audio-scene-audition hash pins still pass).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality: generated C++ always well-formed
Before: 4 of 4 escaping tests red on the old file (raw interpolation sites: 8)
After: 4 of 4 green, raw sites 0; codegen-cue, audition-hash and runtime-contract suites unchanged green
Method: gate: new test red on HEAD copy, green on fix
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/audio-codegen.ts lines (old) 90, 105, 341, 458, 614, 776, 849, 890; new test src/__tests__/lib/audio-codegen-escaping.test.ts

title: getLatestAudioImport orders by createdAt alone while its siblings order by id
body:
## Summary
Two import runs recorded in the same millisecond resolve to an arbitrary row in getLatestAudioImport, while listLatestAudioImportsBySet and getLatestAudioImportForSet deliberately break ties by id.

## Description
src/lib/audio-import-db.ts:45 used ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 1; the doc comment on listLatestAudioImportsBySet states max(id) is used so same-ms runs resolve to the later insert. Fixed with a secondary id DESC.

## Flow
- two recordAudioImport calls in one ms
- getLatestAudioImport
- returns the earlier row on the tie

## Expected impact
The 'latest import' readout cannot show a superseded run. Nothing can break: id is monotonic.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality: deterministic latest-import read
Before: tie test returned id 2, expected 3 (red)
After: returns the later insert (green)
Method: gate: new test red then green
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/audio-import-db.ts:45 vs :52 and :65; test src/__tests__/lib/audio-import-db.test.ts 'same-millisecond ordering'

title: A failed library load renders as an empty library
body:

## Description
src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioLibraryPanel.tsx refresh(): the else branch logged a warning and left data empty, so zero rows and a failed read were identical on screen. - user sees 'No audio yet' and may regenerate content that exists

## Expected impact
A DB or network failure is visible and retryable. Existing library suites unaffected.

## Evaluation
Claim: user: failure distinguishable from empty
Before: 3 cases: error envelope and network rejection both showed the empty message (2 red), empty library showed no alert
After: both failures show an alert with the reason and no empty message (green)
Method: gate: new component tests red then green
Result: better

title: Generated attenuation file computes per-zone settings and never emits them
body:
## Summary
generateAttenuationCpp builds zoneInits (one block per zone with its attenuation radius) and never writes it into the file, so ZoneAttenuations is never populated and GetAttenuationForZone always returns nullptr.

## Description
src/lib/audio-codegen.ts:351 assigns zoneInits and eslint reports it unused (351:9 no-unused-vars); the content template has no InitializeZones and the header declares none. The per-zone attenuationRadius edited in the painter therefore never reaches UE through this file. Fixing means adding an initializer to the header and cpp, which changes the sha256 pins in src/__tests__/lib/audio-scene-audition.test.ts:148-149 and the runtime contract in src/lib/audio-runtime-contract.ts:42.

## Flow
- design zones with different attenuation radii
- generate code
- AudioZoneAttenuation.cpp has only the lookup and factory; map stays empty

## Expected impact
Zone attenuation set in the editor would take effect in generated code. Risk: hash pins and the UE-side contract must move together.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality: edited attenuation reaches generated C++
Before: zone blocks emitted: 0 of N (zoneInits unused)
After: N of N after adding an initializer (not built)
Method: simulation: read of the template and lint output, three-zone walk; instrument is the existing audition hash test which must be re-pinned
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: contract
evidence: eslint: audio-codegen.ts 351:9 'zoneInits' is assigned a value but never used; grep zoneInits across src: only audio-codegen.ts:351

title: A/B candidate runs draw a fresh random seed, so an unchanged candidate diffs to noise
body:
## Summary
handleRun used Math.random() for every run's seed, including the candidate run diffed against a pinned baseline, so two runs of identical tuning disagree and the comparison panel reports a delta that is RNG noise.

## Description
index.tsx handleRun built config.seed from Math.random() each click. The A/B scenarioMismatch banner guards the scenario but not the seed. Fixed: when a baseline is pinned the candidate reuses baselineResult.config.seed (common random numbers); an unpinned run still draws a fresh seed.

## Flow
- pin a baseline
- Run Candidate without changing any slider
- ABComparisonPanel shows non-zero deltas

## Expected impact
A pinned-baseline diff isolates the tuning change. Unpinned runs still explore new seeds.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality: paired A/B comparison
Before: probe on the engine (melee-grunt x3, 1000 iterations, default tuning): DPS delta vs seed 11 baseline was +0.05, -0.07, -0.22, -0.63 on 4 of 5 other seeds
After: same seed gives 0.000 delta; component test asserts the pinned seed is passed
Method: probe: engine run on 5 seeds, plus gate: component test red then green
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/index.tsx handleRun (old line 119); test CombatSimulatorView-states.test.tsx 'reuses the pinned baseline seed'

title: Live region re-announces a stale 'Simulation complete' after a failed run
body:
## Summary
runStatus ignored the store error, so after a failed run (previous summary retained) the polite live region announced a fresh 'Simulation complete: N% survival'.

## Description

## Flow

Claim: user: truthful status announcement

title: recordSpend stores recordedAt verbatim while the budget guard reads UTC date prefixes
body:
## Summary
The budget guard sums rows by substr(recorded_at,1,10/7) of the UTC day, but recordSpend stored the caller's recordedAt as given: an offset stamp landed under the wrong UTC day and an unparseable one matched no window at all (spend invisible to the guard).

## Description
src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts sumCostForPrefix vs recordSpend; POST /api/cli-spend forwards body.recordedAt (route.ts:121). Fixed: utcRecordedAt re-expresses any parseable stamp as its UTC ISO instant and falls back to now otherwise.

## Flow
- POST /api/cli-spend recordedAt '2026-10-12T20:00:00-05:00'
- stored as local text
- UTC-day budget misses it (or 'garbage' is never counted)

## Expected impact
Budget totals count every recorded run in its true UTC day. Existing in-range ISO inputs only gain '.000' millis.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience: budget guard counts what was recorded
Before: offset stamp stored verbatim; unparseable stamp stored verbatim and uncounted (2 red cases)
After: both stored as UTC ISO and counted today (green)
Method: gate: new tests red then green; 31 cli-spend tests pass
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts getBudgetStatus/sumCostForPrefix vs recordSpend; src/app/api/cli-spend/route.ts:121; test cli-spend-db-inputs.test.ts

title: recordSpend accepts negative, NaN and infinite cost and token figures
body:
## Summary
Figures went into cli_spend unchecked, so a negative costUsd (route coerces with Number(x) || 0, which keeps negatives and Infinity) subtracts from the SUM the daily/monthly budget compares to its limit, defeating the guard.

## Description
src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts recordSpend bound input.costUsd/tokens directly; src/app/api/cli-spend/route.ts:110-116. Fixed with spendFigure (finite and >= 0 else 0) and integer rounding for token/duration columns.

## Flow
- POST costUsd: -5
- row stored with -5
- todaySpendUsd drops by 5; dailyExceeded stays false

## Expected impact
A budget cannot be lowered by writing negative spend. Legitimate runs unchanged.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience: the budget guard cannot be cancelled by a bad write
Before: negative/NaN/Infinity figures stored as given (1 red case, 4 rows)
After: all stored as 0; total spend counts only the valid row
Method: gate: new test red then green
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts recordSpend (old lines 343-349); src/app/api/cli-spend/route.ts:110-116

A corrupt row degrades to 'no recorded assets' instead of taking down the list.

Claim: resilience: one bad row cannot fail a list
Before: unguarded JSON.parse in db readers: 1; 3 new cases red
After: 0; 3 cases green; 53 consumer tests pass
Method: gate: new tests red then green
Result: better

title: GET /api/audio-gen walks the whole audio directory with statSync on every call
body:
## Summary
Every GET /api/audio-gen (Library mount and refresh, Sound Forge mount and after each run, the property panel's set library) runs getDiskFootprint, a synchronous recursive readdir+stat over every clip, on the request path.

## Description
src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts:147 and src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:274-291. Cost grows linearly with clips and blocks the event loop; the byte total is only displayed in the Library sidebar. Options: a size column on audio_assets (sum in SQL), or a short-TTL cache invalidated by POST/DELETE.

## Flow
- measure GET with 5k clips
- move bytes into the DB or cache with invalidation

## Expected impact
Faster library loads at scale. Needs a schema change or invalidation design, so not built.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance: GET latency independent of clip count
Before: statSync calls per GET = clip count (e.g. 1 per file)
After: 0 per GET with a size column (not built)
Method: simulation: call-site count; instrument (timing on a seeded 5k-file dir) not built
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:274 getDiskFootprint; src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts:147; callers: AudioLibraryPanel.tsx:98, SoundForgePanel.tsx:64, AudioPropertyPanel/useAudioSetLibrary.ts:51

title: Claim: no busy_timeout on the shared SQLite connection will surface SQLITE_BUSY
body:
## Summary

## Description
Rejected. better-sqlite3 opens connections with a default timeout of 5000 ms (its constructor option), which is the busy handler; db.ts calls new Database(DB_PATH) without overriding it. No change warranted.

## Flow
- checked: db.ts:49 constructor, :66-72 pragmas
- checked: better-sqlite3 ^12.10.0 default timeout

## Expected impact
None.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience: avoid SQLITE_BUSY
Before: premise: no busy handler
After: premise false: 5000 ms default applies
Method: probe: read of constructor call and library default
Result: not-better
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/db.ts constructor call 'new Database(DB_PATH)' (no timeout option); package.json better-sqlite3 ^12.10.0
